text.description_html:
First Impressions 419 Decorative Extra Long Door Stop with Rosette

Constructed of solid brass this Satin Nickel 6" long very decorative wall mount door stop adds a touch of wow to any room. It is equally suited for use in private residential or high end commercial applications.

These extra long door stops are suited for special applications. Typically used to keep a door from hitting a obstacle mounted on a wall. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of First Impressions 419 Reeded Door Stop

  • Total Length: 6"
  • Rosette Diameter: 2-3/8"
  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Sold Individually.



** This item is discontinued. See available Door Stops
